title: A Greedy PDE Router for Blending Neural Operators and Classical Methods
abstract: arXiv:2509.24814v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: When solving PDEs, classical numerical solvers are often computationally expensive, while machine learning methods can suffer from spectral bias, failing to capture high-frequency components. Designing an optimal hybrid iterative solver--where, at each iteration, a solver is selected from an ensemble of solvers to leverage their complementary strengths--poses a challenging combinatorial problem. While greedy selection is desirable for its constant-factor approximation guarantee to the optimal solution under Lipschitz assumptions, it requires knowledge of the true error at each step, which is unavailable in practice. We address this by proposing an approximate greedy router that efficiently mimics a greedy approach to solver selection. Empirical results on the Poisson, convection-diffusion, and anisotropic diffusion equations show that our method consistently reduces time-to-solution relative to single-solver baselines and exist

translated_title: 用于融合神经算子与经典方法的贪心PDE路由器
translated_abstract: 在求解偏微分方程（PDE）时，经典数值求解器通常计算开销较大，而机器学习方法则可能受到谱偏差的影响，无法捕捉高频分量。设计一种最优的混合迭代求解器——即在每次迭代时从求解器集合中选择一个求解器，以利用它们之间互补的优势——构成了一个具有挑战性的组合优化问题。虽然贪心选择方法因其在Lipschitz假设下对最优解具有常数因子近似保证而备受青睐，但它需要知道每一步的真实误差，而这在实践中是无法获得的。我们通过提出一种近似贪心路由器来解决这一问题，该路由器能够高效地模拟求解器选择中的贪心策略。在泊松方程、对流-扩散方程以及各向异性扩散方程上的实证结果表明，与单一求解器基线和现有方法相比，我们的方法能够持续减少求解时间。
tldr: 本文提出一种近似贪心PDE路由器，在混合迭代求解过程中每步智能选择神经算子或经典数值求解器以融合两者优势，在多种PDE求解任务中持续缩短求解时间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an approximate greedy PDE router that intelligently selects between neural operators and classical solvers at each iteration of a hybrid solver, consistently reducing time-to-solution across multiple PDE solving tasks.
